//: Advisories checked by hand against the pinned OpenSSL while its branch is out of support. See "The pinned OpenSSL" in docs/development/dependency-audit.md.

exceptions.reason: QUIC uninitialized stack bytes in peer detection. OpenSSL 3.6.5 is assumed affected, since it shares this code with 3.5 and 4.0. Not reached: the Windows build links OpenSSL only as SQLCipher's crypto provider (libsqlite3-sys 0.38.1 links libcrypto alone, never libssl), and that provider calls only AES-256-CBC, HMAC-SHA1/256/512, PBKDF2-HMAC and RAND. Checked 2026-11-19 in its bundled sqlite3.c: QUIC is in libssl, which isn't linked.
